section3.title: 3. Frequently Asked Questions on PPE Certification

item1.q: What is the difference between HSE regulations and EN standards?
item1.a: HSE regulations set the legal duties for employers in the UK, while EN standards provide the technical criteria that PPE must meet to be compliant.

item2.q: Can I use US (ANSI) certified PPE in UK workplaces?
item2.a: Generally no. PPE in the UK must carry the UKCA or CE mark and meet the relevant EN standards required by the PPE at Work Regulations.

item3.a: Equipment has a manufacturer-defined lifespan. Employers must carry out regular inspections and ensure PPE meets the current consensus standards.

item4.q: How do I verify certified PPE?
item4.a: Check for the UKCA/CE mark and the relevant EN standard (e.g., EN 166 for eyewear) clearly marked on the product or its technical file.
